description: This file declares the interface for the Touchstone integration library, providing functions to check Touchstone status, set server hostname, reset to factory defaults, and restart processes. It is intended for external use to facilitate interaction with the Touchstone system without manual intervention.

methods.name: touchstoneIsActivated
methods.description: Checks if Touchstone is currently activated.

methods.name: touchstoneIsRunning
methods.description: Checks if Touchstone is currently running.

methods.name: touchstoneGetServerHostname
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname of the server Touchstone would activate and communicate with.

methods.name: touchstoneSetServerHostname
methods.description: Attempts to set the hostname of the server Touchstone will activate against.
